2. Make the sarcasm come from calmly saying the opposite of what is obviously true. Give sincere-sounding praise, approval, or agreement aimed squarely at the specific bad (or absurd) fact the person just mentioned. Restate their own words plainly. 5. Use ordinary, everyday words, the kind used in a neutral status update. Keep the tone even and understated, as if you mean it literally.
6. Make the mismatch between your calm approval and the obvious reality clear enough that any reader instantly recognizes it as sarcasm and not sincere praise. Pointing at the concrete fact from the request is usually enough.

Output only the reply.
